course.title: Python Machine Learning
course.subtitle: From data to models you can trust
course.description: Learn machine learning with Python: scikit-learn, honest evaluation, feature engineering, trees and ensembles, clustering, interpretation, deep learning with PyTorch and MLOps, practiced on one fictional company's data.
course.prerequisite: Introduction to Programming with Python, Intermediate Python and Python Data Science (or equivalent)

modules.title: Start Here
modules.description: Set up the ML environment, meet the end-to-end workflow, and get to know the Pinecrest machine-learning data.

lessons.title: Your ML Toolkit
lessons.description: Build the environment, learn the workflow from question to model, and load the Pinecrest ML data.

modules.title: The ML Workflow
modules.description: The habits every project needs: the estimator API, honest splits, cross-validation and the right metric.

lessons.title: The scikit-learn Estimator API
lessons.description: fit, predict, score and transform: train a baseline and a first churn model end to end.

lessons.title: Splits, Baselines and Leakage
lessons.description: Hold out test data properly, stratify, split by time, and catch target leakage.

lessons.title: Cross-Validation
lessons.description: K-fold, stratified, grouped and time-series cross-validation, and what the spread tells you.

lessons.title: Metrics for Classification and Regression
lessons.description: Accuracy, precision, recall, ROC and PR curves, MAE, RMSE and R², and when each misleads.

modules.title: Preparing Data
modules.description: Turn raw tables into model-ready features without leaking information from the test set.

lessons.title: Impute, Scale and Encode
lessons.description: Missing values, scaling and categorical encoding with ColumnTransformer.

lessons.title: Pipelines
lessons.description: Chain preprocessing and models into one leakage-proof object you can tune and save.

lessons.title: Creating Features
lessons.description: Dates, ratios, aggregates and interactions that give a model something to learn.

lessons.title: Feature Selection
lessons.description: Filter, wrapper and embedded methods for dropping redundant and useless features.

lessons.title: Imbalanced Classes
lessons.description: Class weights, resampling and threshold choice when the event you care about is rare.

modules.title: Linear Models
modules.description: The workhorse models: fast, interpretable, and the baseline every other model must beat.

lessons.title: Linear and Logistic Regression
lessons.description: Fit, read and check linear and logistic models on Pinecrest demand and churn.

lessons.title: Regularization and the Bias-Variance Trade-off
lessons.description: Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net and polynomial features; underfitting versus overfitting.

modules.title: Classic Classifiers
modules.description: Three classic ideas about classification: distance, probability and margins.

lessons.title: k-Nearest Neighbors
lessons.description: Classify by similarity, and see why scaling and the choice of k matter.

lessons.title: Naive Bayes
lessons.description: A fast probabilistic classifier, and why it shines on text.

lessons.title: Support Vector Machines
lessons.description: Maximum-margin classifiers and the kernel trick.

modules.title: Trees and Ensembles
modules.description: Decision trees and the ensembles built from them: often the strongest models for tabular data.

lessons.title: Decision Trees
lessons.description: Splits, depth and impurity: a model you can draw, and how it overfits.

lessons.title: Bagging and Random Forests
lessons.description: Many decorrelated trees that vote, with out-of-bag error for free.

lessons.title: Gradient Boosting
lessons.description: HistGradientBoosting, XGBoost and LightGBM: trees that fix each other's mistakes.

lessons.title: Voting and Stacking
lessons.description: Combine different models into one that is better than each.

modules.title: Model Selection and Tuning
modules.description: Choose between models fairly and tune them without fooling yourself.

lessons.title: Model Selection and Learning Curves
lessons.description: Compare models on equal terms; read learning and validation curves.

lessons.title: Hyperparameter Tuning
lessons.description: Grid search, random search, successive halving and Optuna, with nested cross-validation.

modules.title: Explaining Models
modules.description: Find out what a model learned, explain single predictions, and check it for unfairness.

lessons.title: Interpreting Models
lessons.description: Coefficients, permutation importance, partial dependence and ICE plots.

lessons.title: SHAP Values
lessons.description: Explain any prediction as a sum of feature contributions.

lessons.title: LIME and Fairness Checks
lessons.description: Local surrogate explanations, and comparing error rates across groups.

modules.title: Clustering and Anomalies
modules.description: Find structure without labels: customer segments, density, mixtures and outliers.

lessons.title: K-Means Clustering
lessons.description: How K-Means works, why scaling matters, and how to read the clusters.

lessons.title: Choosing k and Customer Segments
lessons.description: Elbow, silhouette and stability; turn clusters into named customer segments.

lessons.title: Hierarchical Clustering
lessons.description: Linkage methods and dendrograms.

lessons.title: Density-Based Clustering
lessons.description: DBSCAN, OPTICS and HDBSCAN: clusters of any shape, and noise.

lessons.title: Gaussian Mixture Models
lessons.description: Soft clustering with probabilities, and choosing components with BIC.

lessons.title: Anomaly Detection
lessons.description: Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor and a payment-fraud project.

modules.title: Dimensionality Reduction
modules.description: Compress many features into a few, for modeling and for pictures.

lessons.title: Principal Component Analysis
lessons.description: Variance, components and how many to keep.

lessons.title: Linear Discriminant Analysis
lessons.description: Supervised projection that separates classes.

lessons.title: t-SNE and UMAP
lessons.description: Nonlinear embeddings for visualization, and how not to over-read them.

modules.title: Deep Learning with PyTorch
modules.description: Neural networks from first principles to pretrained models, all running on an ordinary CPU.

lessons.title: Neural Networks from Scratch
lessons.description: Neurons, layers, loss and gradient descent in NumPy, then with autograd.

lessons.title: PyTorch Fundamentals
lessons.description: Tensors, modules, datasets and the training loop.

lessons.title: Convolutional Neural Networks
lessons.description: Convolutions and pooling; an image classifier for Fashion-MNIST.

lessons.title: Sequence Models
lessons.description: RNNs and LSTMs for daily store sales, and a first look at attention.

lessons.title: Transfer Learning
lessons.description: Reuse a pretrained torchvision model on a small image dataset.

modules.title: Applied ML
modules.description: Two applications every retailer uses: understanding text and recommending products.

lessons.title: Text Classification
lessons.description: Tokens, TF-IDF and a sentiment model for Pinecrest product reviews.

lessons.title: Recommendation Systems
lessons.description: Popularity, item similarity and matrix factorization, evaluated with hit rate.

modules.title: MLOps
modules.description: Make results reproducible, track experiments, and put a model behind an API.

lessons.title: Reproducibility and Experiment Tracking
lessons.description: Seeds, environments, saving models safely and tracking runs with MLflow.

lessons.title: Serving and Monitoring Models
lessons.description: Serve a model with FastAPI and watch for data drift.

modules.title: Capstone
modules.description: Put the whole workflow together: one guided case study, then a project of your own.

lessons.title: Case Study: Predicting Churn
lessons.description: Question, data, features, models, tuning, explanation and a recommendation, end to end.

lessons.title: Capstone Project
lessons.description: Your own Pinecrest ML project, from question to a written model report, with a rubric.

reading.title: AutoML
reading.description: What automated machine learning tools do, and what they cannot do for you.

reading.title: Federated Learning
reading.description: Training a model across many devices without collecting their data.

reading.title: Quantum Machine Learning
reading.description: What quantum computing might and might not change for machine learning.

reading.title: Genetic Algorithms
reading.description: Evolution-inspired search for optimization and feature selection.
